threads.body: `func = function_map.get(call.name)` may be `None` (tool not registered). In that case this wrapper still starts an `execute_tool` span and also derives a description from `None.__doc__` (which is the string "None"), producing an incorrect `gen_ai.tool.description` and emitting an execute_tool span even though no tool can be executed.

@@ -15,6 +15,53 @@
 _reference_tracer = reference_tracer()
 
 
+def _patch_automatic_function_calling():
+    """Emit execute_tool spans from the SDK's automatic-function-calling dispatch.
+
+    `_extra_utils.get_function_response_parts` is where the SDK invokes the
+    application's callable: the `FunctionCall` (id, name, args) and the callable
+    itself are both in scope, so this is the hook generic instrumentation would
+    patch. Wrapping the callable instead would lose the tool call id.
+    """
+    from google.genai import _extra_utils
+
+    original = _extra_utils.get_function_response_parts
+
+    def instrumented(response, function_map):
+        parts = []
+        candidate = response.candidates[0] if response.candidates else None
+        for part in (candidate.content.parts if candidate and candidate.content else None) or []:
+            call = part.function_call
+            if not call or not call.name:
+                continue
+            func = function_map.get(call.name)
+            tool_span_attributes = {
+                "gen_ai.operation.name": "execute_tool",
+                "gen_ai.tool.name": call.name,
+                "gen_ai.tool.type": "function",
+            }
+            description = (getattr(func, "__doc__", None) or "").strip().splitlines()
+            if description:
+                tool_span_attributes["gen_ai.tool.description"] = description[0]

threads.body:
vertexai ends up as the only one of the three execute_tool scenarios added here without `gen_ai.tool.call.id`. That follows from emitting inside `get_weather`: Vertex AI's automatic function calling hands the callable only the model args, so the id never reaches it.

It is available one level up. `AutomaticFunctionCallingResponder.respond_to_model_response` is the dispatch site and has the `FunctionCall` in scope, and `function_call.to_dict().get("id")` picks up the `call_mock_001` the mock server already returns on the v1beta1 path this PR wires up — the v1beta1 `FunctionCall` proto carries `id`, and `Part.function_call` preserves it through `_from_gapic`. Patching there, the same move as `_patch_automatic_function_calling` in the google-genai scenario, would put vertexai in the `gen_ai.tool.call.id` row alongside google-genai and langchain.
